name: Colorado original proceeding (C.A.R. 21)
source_note: The Mandamus-Colorado-09-2026 repository was not readable from this environment (repository not found). This pack is a public-rule scaffold for C.A.R. 21 original proceedings. It is not the original wizard dump. Confirm current Colorado Appellate Rules before filing. This pack never files or serves.

deadlines.label: Petition for rule to show cause (original proceeding)
deadlines.notes: C.A.R. 21 is an extraordinary original proceeding. There is no automatic day-count in this pack. The user supplies the trigger they want calculated.

knowledge_base.title: Jurisdiction
knowledge_base.text: C.A.R. 21 authorizes an original proceeding in the Supreme Court of Colorado. Relief is extraordinary. The user must write why the ordinary appellate path is not adequate. This app will not invent that showing.

knowledge_base.title: Parties
knowledge_base.text: Caption the petitioner and the respondent (often a court or officer). Use the names from the case profile. Do not invent additional parties.

knowledge_base.title: Issues presented
knowledge_base.text: List only issues the user wrote. Each issue should point at a record exhibit when it states a fact.

knowledge_base.title: Relief
knowledge_base.text: State the precise order the user wants (for example a rule to show cause). The app does not file the petition.

forms.title: Petition for rule to show cause (C.A.R. 21)

teach.what_it_is: A petition asking the Supreme Court of Colorado to issue a rule to show cause in an original proceeding. This pack is a public-rule scaffold, not the private Mandamus-Colorado wizard dump.
teach.when_used: When the user believes the ordinary appellate path is not adequate. The user must write that showing. The app will not invent it.
common_mistakes: Treating C.A.R. 21 as a routine appeal with an automatic day count. This pack has no automatic day count.
teach.learn_more: Confirm the current Colorado Appellate Rules. The Mandamus-Colorado-09-2026 repository was not readable from the environment that authored this pack.

situations.label: I need an original proceeding in the Colorado Supreme Court
situations.question: Are you asking the Supreme Court of Colorado for extraordinary relief because the ordinary appeal is not enough?
situations.why: The bundled pack is a C.A.R. 21 scaffold. Relief is extraordinary. There is no automatic day count.

steps.title: Write why the ordinary appellate path is not adequate
steps.why: C.A.R. 21 is not a substitute for a timely appeal. The user supplies that showing.

teach.what_it_is: The heart of an original proceeding: why extraordinary relief is needed.
teach.when_used: Only when the user, not the app, has that reason.
common_mistakes: Letting an agent invent the inadequacy of the ordinary remedy.
teach.learn_more: Read C.A.R. 21 on the Colorado Judicial Branch rules page.
